login.title: Sign in
login.sub: Enter your account details to continue.
setup.title: Welcome — let's set up your system
setup.sub: This takes about a minute. You only do it once.
setup.code_hint: Shown in the server console / logs when the server first started (also saved in SETUP_CODE.txt in the instance folder).
setup.done: System created. Next: activate your licence.
password.policy: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.
pw.change_sub: You will stay signed in here, and all other sessions will be signed out.
pw.force_sub: For your security you must set your own password before continuing.
dash.title: Dashboard
dash.recent_sub: The latest actions recorded in the audit log
dash.no_audit_perm: You do not have permission to view the audit log.
dash.getting_started_sub: Complete these steps to finish preparing the system.
users.title: Users
users.sub: Who can sign in, and what they can do
users.add_sub: Create an account. The user will be asked to choose their own password at first sign-in.
users.password_hint: Leave empty to generate a strong temporary password automatically.
users.username_hint: 3–40 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
users.deactivate_text: The user is signed out immediately and cannot sign in until the account is enabled again.
users.reset_text: A new temporary password is generated and all sessions of this user are signed out.
users.temp_sub: Share this with the user securely. It is shown only once and must be changed at first sign-in.
roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.sub: Decide what each type of user is allowed to do
roles.add_sub: Create a custom role. You choose its permissions next.
roles.list_sub: Select a role to see or edit its permissions
roles.locked_super: The Super Administrator always has every permission and cannot be changed.
roles.locked_admin: Only a Super Administrator can change this role.
roles.locked_own: You cannot change the permissions of your own role.
roles.locked_view: You can view this role but not change it.
company.title: Company & branding
company.sub: The name, logo and colours shown to everyone who uses the system
company.identity_sub: Nothing here is built into the product — it is all yours to configure.
company.app_name_hint: Shown in the title and menu. Example: “Asset Manager”.
company.logo_sub: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 1 MB. Square images look best.
lic.title: Licence
lic.sub: Activation and renewal of this installation
lic.none_sub: Send the activation request code to your vendor, then paste the licence file you receive.
lic.request_sub: Send this code to your vendor to receive a licence for this server.
lic.activate_sub: Paste the contents of the licence file, or choose the file.
lic.revocations_sub: Vendor revocation list (installs a signed list of licences that are no longer valid).
lic.events_sub: Every activation, renewal and state change is recorded.
lic.banner_grace: The licence has expired — grace period
lic.state_grace_hint: The licence has expired but the system keeps working for a short grace period. Renew it now.
lic.state_expired_hint: The licence has expired. Renew it to unlock the system.
lic.state_missing_hint: No licence is installed yet. Activate one to start using the system.
lic.state_invalid_hint: The stored licence could not be verified. Install a valid licence.
lic.state_revoked_hint: This licence was revoked by the vendor. Install a new licence.
lic.state_mismatch_hint: This licence belongs to a different server. Request a licence for this deployment.
lic.state_clock_hint: The server clock moved backwards. Correct the server date/time; the system unlocks automatically.
lic.state_no_key_hint: This build has no vendor key, so licences cannot be verified. Contact your vendor.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.sub: A tamper-evident record of important actions
bk.title: Backups
bk.sub: Database copies you can restore from
bk.keep: The latest {n} backups are kept. A copy is also taken automatically every day and before any upgrade.
bk.where_sub: Copy this folder to another disk or location regularly.
acc.title: My account
err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
err.account_locked: Too many failed attempts. This account is locked for a few minutes.
err.account_disabled: This account is disabled. Contact your administrator.
err.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
err.csrf: Security check failed. Reload the page.
err.bad_setup_code: The setup code is not correct.
err.already_configured: The system is already set up.
err.not_configured: The system is not set up yet.
err.company_name_required: Enter the company name (English or Arabic).
err.username_invalid: Use 3–40 lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
err.password_short: The password must be at least 10 characters.
err.password_common: That password is too easy to guess.
err.password_same: Choose a password different from the current one.
err.password_change_required: You must change your password first.
err.role_not_allowed: You cannot assign a role more powerful than your own.
err.cannot_change_own_role: You cannot change your own role.
err.cannot_disable_self: You cannot disable your own account.
err.cannot_edit_own_role: You cannot change your own role's permissions.
err.last_super_admin: There must always be at least one active Super Administrator.
err.permission_not_allowed: You cannot grant a permission you do not have.
err.role_in_use: Move this role's users to another role first.
err.logo_bad_type: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
err.logo_too_large: The logo must be smaller than 1 MB.
err.license_locked: The system licence is not active. Contact your administrator.
err.license_format: This is not a licence file.
err.license_signature: The licence signature is not valid.
err.license_mismatch: This licence was issued for a different server.
err.license_product: This licence is for a different product.
err.license_no_key: This build cannot verify licences (no vendor key).
err.license_user_limit: Your licence does not allow more active users.
err.license_users_exceeded: The licence allows fewer users than are currently active.
err.revocation_old: A newer revocation list is already installed.
err.forbidden_page: You do not have permission to see this page.
